normal.name: Martyna
normal.text: It is an issue with many cozy games. I would prefer if instead of just pretending that heavier topics don't exist they try to imagine the solution to a better society. I don't expect that from this (excellent!) game, but I would like for cozy creators to be a little more ambitious in their writing.
